'''Corporate Sector gunships''' were used in the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]'s [[Sith armada (Lost Tribe of the Sith)|armada]] in [[44 ABY]]. The [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]-made [[Gunship/Legends|gunships]] were deployed during [[Operation Shieldfall]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. However, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] was defeated by a flight of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[StealthX]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], and forced to retreat.
